product_metadata.title: Creawoo Dog Paw Picture Ornament, Pawprints Picture Frame, Wooden Christmas Photo Ornaments 2022, Perfect Pet Frame Keepsake with Bone Dangle
features: Record Vivid Moment: Time can not be stopped but Creawoo dog paw photo Christmas ornament can help you keep the treasured memories with your puppy. Choose Creawoo, record those invaluable moment with your fur friends.

Dog Paw Shaped Frame, Writable Back: With unique dog paw shaped frame, there is a 2.6*2.1inch space to allow you put your personalized picture, as well as a blank back to allow you write down your best wishes or your lovely pet’s name.

Not Just for Xmas: This pawprints keepsake is not only a perfect addition to your Christmas tree, also a warm decoration for your office, rear view mirror or more. It will be a best gift choice in any holiday or party.
Handmade Artwork with Natural Wood: This puppy picture ornament is carved from double layer black walnut wood and basswood. At the bottom, there is a bone dangle with hollowing “2022”.

Idea & Warm Gift: For those who have lovely puppy, this keepsake ornament will be a creative and memorial gift for them. Its fancy gift box design will also brighten your present in any holiday party. Add it to cart and give it to those who you love!
